AIB-C01 practice exam

Unofficial practice for the AWS Certified AI Business Strategist exam. Not an AWS product.

About the exam
  • 85 questions
  • Multiple choice & multiple response
  • 130 min (exam guide) / 170 min (beta)
  • Pass at 700 (scaled)
  • Blanks count wrong
  • Exam prep plan Official AWS Skill Builder plan for AIB-C01 (English). Free AWS training, not this practice set.
  • AIB-C01 exam guide Domains, question types, timing, and the passing score.
  • Schedule the exam Credential overview and where to schedule the AWS Certified AI Business Strategist exam.

Four exam domains

  1. 1AI Fundamentals and LiteracyFundamentals — concepts, capabilities, and limits in business context.
  2. 2AI Strategy and Business ValueStrategy — use cases, ROI, and when AI is not the answer.
  3. 3AI Governance and Responsible AIGovernance — risk, oversight, and responsible adoption.
  4. 4Business Readiness and TransformationReadiness — people, process, and scaling from pilot to production.
AIB-C01 exam example (scenario stem)

A legal services firm uses a generative AI foundation model on Amazon Bedrock to produce clause-by-clause summaries of commercial lease agreements for paralegals. Leases range from 10 to 180 pages. The integration passes the full text of each lease into a single prompt. After two months, summaries of short leases are reliable, but summaries of long leases consistently omit renewal, termination, and make-good clauses in the final schedules. Logs show no errors. What should the business strategist recommend next? (Full item with answer choices and rationale is in the interactive practice set below.)

FAQ

What is the AWS Certified AI Business Strategist (AIB-C01) exam?
AIB-C01 is an AWS certification exam for business professionals who evaluate, champion, or scale AI initiatives. It tests AI strategy, business value, governance, and organizational readiness through scenario questions—not hands-on AWS implementation or coding.
How long is the AIB-C01 exam and what score do you need to pass?
Per the public exam guide, the sitting is 85 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions. The exam guide lists 130 minutes; the beta overview lists 170 minutes. Scores are reported on a 100–1,000 scale; 700 is the minimum passing score. Unanswered questions count as incorrect.
Is this the official AWS AIB-C01 practice test?
No. This is an unofficial practice set built as a duskyAI side project. It is not the AWS Certification Official Practice Question Set, not exam content from AWS, and not endorsed by AWS.
What does an AIB-C01 exam question look like?
Items are short business scenarios with constraints and a single best next step (or multiple correct responses on some items). You reason about strategy, value, governance, and readiness—not which API to call.
Amazon AI certificate and “Amazon Certified AI Business Strategist”
People often search for an Amazon AI certificate or Amazon Certified AI Business Strategist. The credential name from AWS is AWS Certified AI Business Strategist (AIB-C01).
